title.en: Surgery with a sticky note? The promise—and the next human test.
title.zh: 手术像贴便条？黏合技术的希望与下一场人体试验。

summary.en: SanaHeal’s wet-tissue adhesive has trauma-bleeding approval according to MIT; broader surgical trials are planned for2027. Less stitching is a possibility, not a proven universal replacement.
summary.zh: 据MIT报道，SanaHeal湿组织黏合技术已获止创伤出血批准，更广手术应用拟于2027年开展人体试验；少缝针是可能性，非普遍替代已获证实。

title.en: The AI joins the orchestra. Who gets heard?
title.zh: AI加入交响乐，谁的声音被听见？

summary.en: Tod Machover’s new symphony uses Live AI to connect human musicians; its October22–24 Boston performances remain ahead of this report. The democracy is a musical idea, not a measured political result.
summary.zh: Tod Machover新交响曲以Live AI连接真人乐手，波士顿10月22至24日演出尚未举行；民主是音乐构想，非经验证的政治效果。
